plugins.name: software-company
plugins.description: Complete software development company simulation with 12 roles (Product Manager, Project Manager, BA, SA, Architect, UX, Developer, Tester, DevOps, Security Engineer, Tech Writer, SEO), 10 specialized skills (including polished-document-style for stakeholder-ready docs with Mermaid diagrams), and slash commands for common SDLC workflows. Each agent includes Initial Discovery and Performance Targets sections aligned with industry standards.
